generation.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: source-conditioned PBR albedo specimen for a 3D architectural model
Primary request: derive a seamless, square, shadow-neutral warm aged limestone surface from the approved limestone visible in the reference crest image.
Input image: the supplied fire-service crest plaque is the material reference only.
Composition: flat orthographic surface, edge-to-edge repeatable stone field, no perspective.
Lighting: completely even diffuse capture; remove cast shadows, highlights, ambient occlusion and directional illumination.
Materials/textures: preserve the exact warm beige limestone hue, fine mineral grain, subtle age variation and restrained pores from the plaque. The output represents smoothly dressed/carved limestone stock, so do not include block joints or mortar.
Constraints: seamless/tileable on all edges; material-only albedo; no crest, eagle, shield, relief, border, arch, moulding, ornament, text, cracks, seams, blocks, joints, windows, shadows, watermark, or facade fragments. Keep variation subtle enough for use on quoins, arches, cornices, opening returns, dormer surrounds, cupola columns and a crest carrier.
